title: Kinetic typography
caption: The kinetic-typography recipe: big, tight statement lines with the key words in the brand colour over an accent underline, for hooks and bold messages.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 6-second 16:9 hook for Magnifito in the kinetic-typography style: two 3-second lines, "Digital marketing with heart and value" and "Meet Magnifito. One team from first idea to launch", with the second half of each line emphasised. Link the one-team line to its approved claim in claims.json. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, the logo green #8acf31 used sparingly, Geist from fonts/, and the logo in assets/magnifito-logo.svg. Render it with HyperFrames.
